home.heroDesc: Encrypt your Agent payloads with ECIES. Sell them as subscriptions. Let agents collaborate via A2A protocol. The first truly decentralized agent economy — not a platform, a protocol.
home.whyDesc: Four pillars that make AgentX fundamentally different from every AI agent platform.
home.pillar1Desc: AES-256-GCM + ECIES double encryption. Your Agent payload exists on IPFS as ciphertext — readable only by active subscribers with the decryption key on-chain.
home.pillar2Desc: Publish proprietary strategies as remote MCP tools. Subscribers invoke them — they never see your source code. Your edge stays yours.
home.pillar3Desc: Agents talk to agents. Create autonomous chains: audit → deploy → monitor. Every step on-chain, auditable, and composable.
home.pillar4Desc: Inject your Agent into any LLM via @agentx/sdk. OpenAI, Claude, local models — no lock-in. The Agent travels, the platform stays out of the way.
home.howHeadline: Three Steps to Your Agent Economy
home.step1Desc: Write a prompt. Attach skills with JSON Schemas. Connect MCP tools. All in a 4-step visual wizard.
home.step2Desc: One-click AES + ECIES encryption. Payload goes to IPFS. Encryption key locked on-chain. Minted as an NFT.
home.step3Desc: Users subscribe with ETH on-chain. SDK auto-decrypts. Agent injected into their chat. Revenue flows to you.
home.securityDesc: Every Agent payload is AES-256-GCM encrypted before touching IPFS. The AES key is then wrapped with the subscriber's ECIES public key. Only the subscription NFT holder can decrypt. No backend. No trusted third party.
home.securityItem4: Compatible with @agentx/sdk out of the box
home.secOnChainAction: ECIES wraps AES key → stored in metadata
home.secSubscriberAction: ECIES decrypts key → fetches IPFS → AES decrypts
home.ctaTitle: Ready to Build the Agent Economy?
home.ctaDesc: Mint your first Agent in under 5 minutes. No backend. No platform lock-in. Just you and your Agent, on-chain.

b.signInSubtitle: Integrate conversational AI into your product. Sign in with your wallet to create your business tenant and receive your dedicated API key — no application review.
b.perk1Desc: Connect your wallet — a B-end tenant and agentx_ key are provisioned automatically.
b.perk2Desc: One gateway for chat, parallel tasks & on-chain data. Pay per token via a subscription.
b.perk3Desc: Monitor quota consumption in your console and upgrade as you grow.
b.connectWalletTitle: Connect your wallet to get started
b.connectWalletDesc: Use the Connect Wallet button in the top-right corner. A signature is requested to verify ownership — one wallet maps to one business tenant.
b.consumerHint: Already registered as a consumer? Use a different wallet for your business account.
b.wrongKindTitle: This wallet is already a consumer account
b.wrongKindDesc: One wallet maps to a single tenant. To create a business account, connect a different wallet — or continue using your existing account for personal usage.
b.keyRevealSub: Here is your dedicated API key.
b.keyRevealWarning: Shown only once. For security we store only a fingerprint of your key. If you lose it, key rotation arrives with the full business console.
b.noPlanDesc: Your business tenant is created, but platform LLM usage requires a subscription. Until then you can still integrate with your own LLM key (BYOK) — or subscribe to unlock metered platform models.
b.step1: Call the gateway with your API key: X-Api-Key header or agentx_ key.
b.step2: Use POST /api/v1/agent/runs for streaming chat and POST /api/v1/sessions/:id/tasks for parallel tasks.
b.step3: Track token usage here in your console as it accrues.

billing.planActiveDesc: Your daily quota has been updated. Billing continues automatically via the platform.
billing.x402NotEnabled: The x402 payment rail is not enabled on this Gateway yet (X402_ENABLED / X402_PAY_TO).

billing.keyFingerprintDesc: Your key is stored as a fingerprint and was shown once at sign-up. If you lost it, rotate to mint a replacement — the previous key stops working immediately.
billing.x402RailDisabled: The x402 pay-per-request rail is not enabled on this Gateway yet (X402_ENABLED / X402_PAY_TO).
billing.topUpCoversA2a: Top-ups also cover A2A pay-per-call access (balance-mode x402).
